method: GitHub REST repository and license endpoints; repository trees and manifest files inspected at the recorded default branch. No repository was cloned or added as a dependency.

policy.copyRule: Only small, independently extractable modules with a permissive license and a clear dependency boundary may be adapted. GPL-family and unidentified licenses are reference-only.
policy.contentRule: Code license and content license are separate. 408/site content remains personal-study and is not made redistributable by this audit.

projects.name: learn-from-materials

license.name: MIT License
license.evidence: GitHub License API plus repository NOTICE.md

reusableModules: material facts separated from model-added content
securityNotes: Extraction outputs must be sanitized before rendering.
Keep source quotes and generated content distinguishable.
projects.decisionReason: Adopt the traceability and validation concepts, not the HTML renderer or agent runtime.

projects.name: Exameow
reusableModules: question kind and review-state domain model
human review before generated questions are published
securityNotes: AI-generated answers require answer-change review and source checks.
projects.decisionReason: Reuse the state machine and review boundaries; do not embed Tauri/Vue or its AI runtime.

projects.name: Aether

license.name: Other
license.evidence: GitHub License API returned Other/NOASSERTION; LICENSE text is not a recognized standard license

securityNotes: Do not copy source until the license is clarified.
CDN-loaded rendering assets require a separate CSP and availability review.
projects.decisionReason: License is not sufficiently identified and the implementation is small; use product ideas only.

projects.name: learning-platform
securityNotes: Prisma/SQLite persistence is not a drop-in fit for PostgreSQL.
Avoid importing its authentication or execution surface without a separate threat review.
projects.decisionReason: Useful schema ideas, but low maintenance signal and tightly coupled webapp make direct extraction a poor tradeoff.

projects.name: Moodle

license.name: GNU General Public License v3.0
license.evidence: GitHub License API and composer.json license field

runtimeDependencies: many PHP extensions and Composer packages

reusableModules: question categories, tags and feedback structures
securityNotes: Do not copy GPL code into this project without an explicit distribution decision.
Question XML must be parsed defensively and HTML sanitized.
projects.decisionReason: Use the documented interchange formats and lifecycle ideas; do not embed or copy the GPL platform.

projects.name: Examination-System
reusableModules: wrong-answer review and score trend ideas
securityNotes: Browser-local storage is not a substitute for server-side progress.
Imported question banks need duplicate and schema checks.
projects.decisionReason: Small zero-runtime-dependency modules and interaction patterns can be adapted after targeted tests.
